limitations: Synthetic faults and isolated Chrome establish UI response ordering, not real provider/customer data, payment execution or backend status guarantees.
Real Telegram/iOS/WebKit, human comprehension and screen-reader announcements remain unverified. No messages, credentials, signatures or money operations were used in this acceptance review.
Newest-request ownership does not establish snapshot freshness on the server. This slice adds no deadline; latest unresolved fetch/body stays visibly loading until a subsequent request settles.
The next-prerequisite scheduler horizon is simulated and schedules no timer; it is not a claim of 30 seconds elapsed on a real network or native streaming-body cancellation.
This PASS covers the bounded reversible HTML change and does not close E4 or advance earlier gates. Production replacement and runtime verification remain the primary agent’s next step.
